initial_prompt: I'm trying to write a loop in Python to sum numbers in a list, but I keep getting an index out of range error. I don't get why range(len(list)) is failing when I try to access list[i+1].

messages.content: I'm trying to write a loop in Python to sum numbers in a list, but I keep getting an index out of range error. I don't get why range(len(list)) is failing when I try to access list[i+1].

Let's trace the loop boundaries to see exactly where it breaks.

If your list has 5 items, `range(len(list))` will generate indices `0, 1, 2, 3, 4`.

In the very last iteration of the loop, `i` is **4**. At that specific moment, what index is the code trying to access when you request `list[i+1]`?
